findings.summary: Unauthenticated remote class instantiation via SOAP fault exceptionName allows for remote code execution.

findings.title: Perforce Puppet Enterprise RCE
findings.summary: A deserialization vulnerability in report-processing code allows arbitrary code execution on the Puppet Server.

findings.title: Apache Roller RCE
findings.summary: An unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability exists in the Apache Roller XML-RPC endpoint due to unsafe deserialization.

findings.title: Oracle Java 'Java4Shell' RCE
findings.summary: A critical pre-authentication remote code execution vulnerability exists in the Oracle Java compiler component.

findings.title: NGINX HTTP/2 RCE and DoS
findings.affected_technology: F5 NGINX Open Source and Plus
findings.summary: Two vulnerabilities in the ngx_http_v2_module can lead to heap buffer overflows or use-after-free conditions.
